## About
Crash Auto Parts LLC serves the Detroit area with quality used parts. You'll find us at 3465 S Fort St, open Monday through Friday.
Customers have given us a 4.9 rating across 432 Google reviews. One reviewer said they were shown the parts and allowed to compare them with others before buying, and another said a part was exactly as Dan described and worked perfectly.

## Services
- Quality used parts: Used parts for drivers and shops in the Detroit area.
- Used auto parts: One customer recommended us to anyone looking for used auto parts.
- Wheel and tire: One customer said Dan put a wheel on and their original tire back on.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: We're open Monday through Friday and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can I search your inventory online?
A: Yes. Our website has inventory search, including search by image and multi-part search.
